directivePlacement.text: The FLAG-02 directive may be specified only between clauses in divisions other than the procedure division and only between statements in the procedure division

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.14.2 general format: a list of syntax-option words with ON/OFF (§2023:7.3.14.3 GR4 names the options) — a structured operand, diagnosed by its own stage as COBOL1622.

description: The >>FLAG-02 { ALL | option... } { ON | OFF } migration-flagging directive (ISO §2023:7.3.14) — introduced in COBOL-2014 to flag 2002-to-2014 incompatibilities (GR1; the directive references the 2014 edition, and Annex E.2 item 5 lists only FLAG-14 as new to 2023, so FLAG-02 predates 2023). It is OBSOLETE (NOT removed) in COBOL-2023 — §2023:7.3.14.1 NOTE: 'an obsolete element in this Working Draft International Standard and is to be deleted from the next edition'. Per §2023:4.2.13 an implementation SHALL SUPPORT obsolete elements, so at 2023 it STILL COMPILES and carries the COBOL0903 obsolete warning (never a 0902 removal error). Modeled introducedIn=2014 + obsoleteIn=2023: the introduction gate rejects below 2014, the obsolete gate warns at 2023.
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.14; §2023:7.3.14.1 NOTE (obsolete in 2023); §2023:4.2.13 (obsolete elements shall be supported + warned)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FLG02.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
       >>FLAG-02 I-O-STATUS-07 ON
           DISPLAY "Y".
           STOP RUN.
